sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Energy Products Distribution is a Master Distributor of 3M films and coatings for automotive, architectural, and residential applications.

Industry: Distribution · Size: <$50M · Products: 3M Graphic Films, 3M Window Films, 3M Paint Protection Films, 3M Wrap Films, 3M Architectural Finishes, 3M Ceramic Coatings

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Energy Products Distribution scores 61 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (28/30) and application fit (24/25). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (70% similar on films, protection, wrap, window); Mactac (42% similar on films, vinyl, protection, graphic); ORAFOL Europe (38% similar on films, graphic, automotive, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
